added.summary: Colour-blind modes as a player setting: protanopia, deuteranopia or tritanopia. The whole frame, scene and UI alike, is recoloured after every other effect: corrected by daltonisation (the default) or simulated for checking a screen (UiDesc.colorVisionFilter), at UiDesc.colorVisionStrength. Simulation is Viénot 1999 and Brettel 1997 from libDaltonLens; correction is Fidaner 2005.
The colour vision setting in effect, with its filter and strength.

Document CSS reads the player's colour vision: `(-og-color-vision)` for any mode, `(-og-color-vision: deuteranopia)` for one; a retained mount restyles only the elements that read it when the setting changes.
An <icon> draws a colour token's icon cue (`-og-cue: danger`, a status, rarity, team or damage type), the icon the style pairs with that colour, so a state never rests on colour alone.
